broad_vina_support.definition: complete DOCKSTRING support after excluding every row whose raw InChIKey connectivity block occurs in DAVIS or PKIS2

claim_boundary: The audit measures stability of one k=8 decision on the fixed 21-target panel. It does not measure affinity accuracy, compound ranking or transfer to unseen targets. Repetitions perturb ligands, not targets or assays.
evaluation: exact panel rank, loss and headroom on fixed released-informative DAVIS and PKIS2 row-centered maps; experimental values never enter selection

choice_grid_adjustment.cell_statistic: maximum of the exact DAVIS and PKIS2 all-panel percentiles; smaller requires a panel to rank well on both experimental maps
choice_grid_adjustment.choice_grid: raw and row-centered-residual transformations crossed with k=[4, 6, 8, 10, 12], signed distance 1-r
choice_grid_adjustment.global_statistic: minimum cell statistic over the full choice grid
choice_grid_adjustment.permutation_contract: one common permutation of the 21 target labels is applied to every fixed Vina-selected set in a replicate; experimental percentile distributions and all selection choices remain fixed

full_source_k_sensitivity.enumeration: complete C(21,k) enumeration independently at every k
full_source_k_sensitivity.interpretation: k=8 is one inherited illustrative compression size and is exceptional in the observed residual transfer. Claims about panel compression must use the full k grid or explicitly label k=8 as illustrative.

same_endpoint_centering_comparison.boundary: This is fixed-target map coverage, not affinity prediction, compound ranking, or retrieval of unseen targets. The k-averaged comparison avoids selecting the exceptionally favorable inherited k=8 result. Sequence is a substantive baseline and no Vina-over-sequence superiority claim is made.
same_endpoint_centering_comparison.column_rank_sensitivity: rank ligands independently within every experimental target before row centring; this removes target-wise monotone scale and reduces the influence of DAVIS floor censoring
same_endpoint_centering_comparison.comparison: raw-Vina-selected versus row-centered-residual-Vina-selected fixed panels, both evaluated on the same residual experimental endpoint

deterministic_tie_contract.numerical_optimum_set: every enumerated panel whose Vina objective is no more than 1e-12 above the enumerated minimum
deterministic_tie_contract.primary_panel: first minimum in the complete lexicographic C(21,k) enumeration; no optimizer tolerance or outcome-dependent tie breaking
deterministic_tie_contract.tie_sensitivity: for every experimental endpoint cell, all raw-optimal crossed with all residual-optimal panels are evaluated. The conservative cell contrast is best raw minus worst residual; pooled inference averages that contrast across the fixed k grid and both panels under the same shared target-label null

same_endpoint_centering_comparison.multiplicity: signed 1-r is the prespecified scientific objective. The max-over-three p-value is reported as a retrospective objective-choice sensitivity; metric residual and column-rank endpoints are not pooled as duplicate confirmatory tests
same_endpoint_centering_comparison.outcome_blind_sequence_baseline: at every k, exact sequence-diverse panels minimize mean nearest distance 1-global-receptor-sequence-identity and are evaluated on the same experimental endpoints as both Vina selectors; sequence uses no experimental outcome
same_endpoint_centering_comparison.permutation_contract: one common permutation of the 21 target labels is applied to every fixed raw- and residual-Vina selected set across both panels, all k, and all three objectives in a replicate; experimental maps and exact all-panel distributions remain fixed
same_endpoint_centering_comparison.primary_inference: one-sided shared target-label permutation test for the conservative tie-robust coverage-loss contrast. Deterministic lexicographic and tie-averaged contrasts are co-reported; exact-percentile inference is scale-normalized sensitivity
same_endpoint_centering_comparison.primary_statistic: signed-1-r conservative best-raw-optimum minus worst-residual-optimum coverage-loss improvement, averaged over the prespecified k grid and both panels; numerical Vina optima use the declared absolute tolerance

same_endpoint_cluster_multiplier_bootstr.boundary: Intervals perturb chemical support within each released panel. They do not sample target identity, assay technology, or the kinase universe.
same_endpoint_cluster_multiplier_bootstr.primary_bootstrap_aggregate: mean raw-minus-residual selected-panel coverage-loss improvement over the five prespecified k values and both experimental panels
same_endpoint_cluster_multiplier_bootstr.resampling_contract: independent positive Exp(1) weights are assigned to every panel-specific Butina chemical cluster and inherited by all ligands in that cluster; all clusters remain represented and DAVIS/PKIS2 draws share only the repetition index
same_endpoint_cluster_multiplier_bootstr.selector_contract: raw- and residual-Vina panels are fixed once at every k on the full de-leaked broad Vina source; sequence panels are fixed from global receptor identity; experimental values never enter selection
same_endpoint_cluster_multiplier_bootstr.tie_robust_bootstrap: all Vina panels within absolute 1e-12 of each enumerated selector minimum are propagated; conservative best-raw minus worst-residual and tie-averaged contrasts are summarized

selection: exact minimizer among all C(21,8) panels of mean nearest signed distance 1-r on the row-centered calibration Vina map

sequence_geometry_control.boundary: The control tests fixed-panel sequence-related geometry. It does not show that Vina is superior to sequence or that either map predicts affinity for unseen targets.

provenance.residue_normalization: defined by the frozen manifest/fetch producer; every loaded sequence is checked against its manifest length and SHA-256
provenance.source: exact receptor-domain sequences parsed from DOCKSTRING 0.3.4 PDBQT resources
provenance.tie_symmetrization: mean identity from the first optimal alignment in both sequence orientations; removes arbitrary target-order dependence under tied optimal BLOSUM62 alignments

sequence_geometry_control.qap_contract: one common target-label permutation of the fixed sequence-identity map is used for raw, residual and residual-minus-raw statistics in every replicate; Vina maps remain fixed
sequence_geometry_control.statistic: Pearson correlation across the 210 unique target-pair edges
